review_units.title: Front matter and abstract
review_units.boundary: Motivation and publication context; not executable requirements.

review_units.title: Minimal fix/mix nucleus
review_units.boundary: Typed composition exists; runtime fixed point is unsafe and can diverge; no whole Scheme/Lean correspondence proof.

review_units.title: Claims and reading plan
review_units.boundary: Broad OOP expressiveness claims are not established by local examples.

review_units.title: Modular increments of computation
review_units.boundary: Open self/inherited inputs and generators; typed Lean adaptation of untyped Scheme.

review_units.title: Applicability to other languages
review_units.boundary: No requirement to implement every language discussed.

review_units.title: Records as functions
review_units.boundary: Dependent key/value family and Option missing values; no arbitrary Scheme message interface.

review_units.title: Record prototypes
review_units.boundary: slotGen, self and delayed inherited values; example outputs are observations.

review_units.title: Paper basic checks
review_units.boundary: Representative outputs exist; exact replay of every original @Checks case is not established.

review_units.title: Building record prototypes
review_units.boundary: Typed slot/modify/compute constructors; source expected-value suite not fully replicated.

review_units.title: Long-form basics and ordered composition
review_units.boundary: Heterogeneous chain types and local laws; no paper operational-semantics relation.

review_units.title: Bottom and missing behavior
review_units.boundary: Option, explicit callbacks and runtime divergence are different boundaries; no common untyped bottom formalization.

review_units.title: Single inheritance
review_units.boundary: Typed child-over-parent composition and extension.

review_units.title: Order prototype case
review_units.boundary: No corresponding end-to-end number/string/symbol order prototypes plus compare mixin found. C4 order relations do not implement this data-order example.

review_units.title: Binary-tree dictionary case
review_units.boundary: No corresponding open-recursive binary-tree map node/acons/ref/afoldr implementation and paper-output controls found.

review_units.title: AVL override case
review_units.boundary: No corresponding node-only rebalance mixin, rotations, height checks or paper five-entry dictionary controls found.

review_units.title: Numeric functions and number thunks
review_units.boundary: Representative numeric computations; observed outputs do not replay all paper checks.

review_units.title: Computations rather than values
review_units.boundary: Delayed self/super computes non-function values; premature forcing can diverge.

review_units.title: Use without subtyping
review_units.boundary: Explicit Lean intermediate types replace paper subtyping notation.

review_units.title: Slot introspection
review_units.boundary: Finite declared keys and enumeration; not arbitrary dynamic Scheme message discovery.

review_units.title: Alternative instance/prototype representations
review_units.boundary: Several representations and local resolver equivalences exist; paper AVL-backed representation route is absent.

review_units.title: Unified instance/prototype objects
review_units.boundary: Retained prototype/value pair and later extension; typed carriers and unsafe recursive instantiation.

review_units.title: Multiple inheritance
review_units.boundary: Main object order is C4; paper uses C3. Shared merge concepts and local proofs are not whole-policy equivalence.

review_units.title: Prototype as extensible meta-object
review_units.boundary: Typed schema/plan metadata exists; self-hosted dynamic meta-object protocol with overridable function/supers/precedence slots is not established.

review_units.title: Further feature overview
review_units.boundary: Points to advanced extensions; evaluate the concrete Appendix B constructions separately.

review_units.title: Classes as descriptor prototypes
review_units.boundary: Runtime descriptors compose over a fixed Lean carrier type; Scheme dynamic type universe not reproduced.

review_units.title: I/O validation
review_units.boundary: JSON/text/byte and slot refinement controls; Lean wire format, not Scheme binary compatibility.

review_units.title: Simple type repertoire
review_units.boundary: Selected Lean carriers and recognizers exist; no exhaustive mapping of all dynamic Scheme simple-type distinctions.

review_units.title: Parameterized descriptors
review_units.boundary: List/array/map/option/product/sum/HList construction; typed rather than unrestricted dynamic values.

review_units.title: Self-describing elaborate descriptors
review_units.boundary: Function and object descriptors exist; self-description of all descriptor/prototype machinery and generated automation not established.

review_units.title: Classes/typeclasses correspondence
review_units.boundary: TypedValue and descriptors do not prove an automated bidirectional transformation between typeclasses and prototype classes.

review_units.title: Pure linearity and mutable/functional interaction
review_units.boundary: IO identity cells and persistent snapshots exist; no linear ownership calculus or pure/mutable isomorphism theorem.

review_units.title: Simplified mutable prototype protocol
review_units.boundary: Parent/child effects share identity; standard layers stage persistent schema edits, not literal in-place Scheme hash mutation.

review_units.title: Cache invalidation alternatives
review_units.boundary: Explicit dependency contracts and proof reuse are local extensions; no language-wide purity/effect inference or arbitrary-body invalidation.

review_units.title: Related work
review_units.boundary: Other systems and semantic literature are context, not features to reproduce.

review_units.title: Future research
review_units.boundary: Generalized MOP, full dependent formal treatment and staging/cache proposals remain research, not already-closed paper semantics.

review_units.title: Executable Racket library context
review_units.boundary: The original literate Racket/Scheme evaluator was not run or differentially compared by this audit.

review_units.title: Appendix A C3 algorithm
review_units.boundary: Structural merge proofs and C4 tests exist; standalone paper C3 graph/results and exact policy correspondence not established.

review_units.title: Appendix A helper functions
review_units.boundary: Lean constructors cover selected operations; no all-helper semantic translation checklist.

review_units.title: Appendix A extra checks
review_units.boundary: Selected object mixing cases observed; every paper expected value not guarded.

review_units.title: Appendix B multiple dispatch
review_units.boundary: Typed registration, per-context selection and cache controls; not a formal resolution of every cross-library extension/conflict policy in the discussion.

review_units.title: Appendix B method fragments
review_units.boundary: Ordered before/after/around/primary and user combinations; no CLOS syntax or universal standard-combination correspondence.

review_units.title: Appendix B generalized lens constructor
review_units.boundary: lensGen implements getter/setter/wrapper and skew-focus laws exist. The paper itself calls full generalized prototypes future work; no claim that all such semantics are closed.

review_units.title: Appendix C type notation
review_units.boundary: Lean dependent types replace expository notation; no formal source row/subtyping calculus translation is established.

review_units.title: Appendix D fixed-point functions
review_units.boundary: Shared unsafe thunk knot plus bounded diagnostics; no all eager/lazy/Y variants equivalence or universal termination theorem. Divergence is allowed by the paper.

review_units.title: Appendix E code minimalism
review_units.boundary: Scheme cons-cell/character counts are illustrative, not Lean size or semantic requirements.
